sm3Obligations.proof: The generic cross-process writer lease, exact Pipeline reentrant token, live contention, lease-loss abort, and orphan recovery are covered by workspace-write-lease and pipeline-workspace-write-lease owners.

Retained isolated transactions, same-volume staging and backup, lease-internal fresh replan, source/base/plan CAS, atomic publish, and committed-digest rollback are covered by Semantic Mutation apply owners.

Immutable generation journals, exact replay/query, durable terminal receipts, 256-terminal retention, prepared/rolled-back/recovery-required recovery, and third-party failure preservation are covered by deterministic and real lifecycle owners.

invariants: Shared install, isolated capability publication, prebound-only readiness, copy, and launch proof consume one package-name contract.
Every required package must expose a nonempty package.json with the exact name and a nonempty installed version.
An incomplete install never publishes a ready stamp.
Runtime module resolution is evaluated against the current canonical dependency state and does not cache an early missing-tree fallback.
The production sentinel no longer overlays dependencyModules or duplicates compiler-owned sources.
Managed Git hook generations bind canonical commands to the shell-quoted process.execPath identity instead of caller PATH.
Internal gate snapshots disable checkout hooks and enable Git long-path materialization, so snapshot creation cannot launch dependency installation or depend on parent path depth.
